data.description: Standard format (or Standard) is one of Hearthstone's three game formats in Constructed. Standard format is intended to feature a fresher and more focused Hearthstone experience, with a limited pool of cards allowing greater design space, a more dynamically shifting meta, more balanced play, and an easier...

				<h1 id="firstHeading" class="firstHeading mw-first-heading"><span class="mw-page-title-main">Standard format</span></h1>
				<div id="bodyContent" class="vector-body">
					<div id="siteSub" class="noprint">From Hearthstone Wiki</div>
					<div id="contentSub"></div>
					<div id="contentSub2"></div>
					
					<div id="jump-to-nav"></div>
					<a class="mw-jump-link" href="#mw-head">Jump to navigation</a>
					<a class="mw-jump-link" href="#searchInput">Jump to search</a>
					<div id="mw-content-text" class="mw-body-content"><div class="mw-content-ltr mw-parser-output" lang="en" dir="ltr"><div class="center"><div class="floatnone"><a href="/wiki/File:Year_of_the_Scarab_banner.jpg" class="image"><img alt="Year of the Scarab banner.jpg" src="/images/thumb/Year_of_the_Scarab_banner.jpg/500px-Year_of_the_Scarab_banner.jpg?cd1e63" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="500" height="178" data-file-width="1520" data-file-height="540"></a></div></div>
<div class="floatright"><a href="/wiki/File:Year_of_the_Scarab.png" class="image"><img alt="Year of the Scarab.png" src="/images/thumb/Year_of_the_Scarab.png/200px-Year_of_the_Scarab.png?640eef" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="200" height="223" data-file-width="596" data-file-height="664"></a></div><p><b>Standard format</b> (or <b>Standard</b>) is one of <i>Hearthstone</i>'s three <a href="/wiki/Game_format" title="Game format">game formats</a> in <a href="/wiki/Constructed" title="Constructed">Constructed</a>. Standard format is intended to feature a fresher and more focused <i>Hearthstone</i> experience, with a limited pool of cards allowing greater design space, a more dynamically shifting <a href="/wiki/Meta" title="Meta">meta</a>, more balanced play, and an easier entry for new players.
</p><p>Games played in Standard format are restricted to <a href="/wiki/Card" title="Card">cards</a> from <a href="/wiki/Card_set" title="Card set">card sets</a> released in the previous two calendar years, in addition to the <a href="/wiki/Core" title="Core">Core</a> set. The lack of older expansion sets makes Standard format friendlier for <a href="/wiki/New_player_experience" title="New player experience">new players</a>.
</p><p>During Standard matches, <a href="/wiki/Random" class="mw-redirect" title="Random">random</a> effects that produce cards are also restricted to only choosing from Standard sets, although non-random effects worded to generate specific Wild cards continue to function normally.
</p><p>Standard is available as a format in <a href="/wiki/Constructed" title="Constructed">Constructed</a> matches (<a href="/wiki/Ranked" title="Ranked">Ranked</a> and <a href="/wiki/Casual" class="mw-redirect" title="Casual">Casual</a>), and <a href="/wiki/Friendly_Challenge" title="Friendly Challenge">Friendly Challenges</a>. In addition, <a href="/wiki/Tavern_Brawl" title="Tavern Brawl">Tavern Brawls</a> may occasionally use Standard format.<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Standard is the default format for new players, and is used in all official tournaments such as the <a href="/wiki/Hearthstone_Grandmasters" title="Hearthstone Grandmasters">Hearthstone Grandmasters</a> and <a href="/wiki/Hearthstone_World_Championship" title="Hearthstone World Championship">Hearthstone World Championship</a>.
</p><p>The prefix Standard is used to refer to cards, game modes, and adventures which fall within the Standard format, or which are only available in Standard format. For example, a Standard adventure is one which is currently part of Standard format. Furthermore, cards which are valid for the current Standard year are termed Standard cards.
</p><p>Standard format is updated annually when the first new expansion of the year is released, marking the start of the new "<a href="#The_Standard_year">Standard year</a>". Standard format was released together alongside <i><a href="/wiki/Whispers_of_the_Old_Gods" title="Whispers of the Old Gods">Whispers of the Old Gods</a></i> and <a href="/wiki/Wild_format" title="Wild format">Wild format</a> on April 26, 2016.<sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> At that time, <i><a href="/wiki/Curse_of_Naxxramas" title="Curse of Naxxramas">Curse of Naxxramas</a></i> and <i><a href="/wiki/Goblins_vs_Gnomes" title="Goblins vs Gnomes">Goblins vs Gnomes</a></i> were sent to the new Wild format, making cards from those sets unavailable in Standard format play.
</p>

<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="Playing_in_Standard">Playing in Standard</span><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/wiki/Standard_format?veaction=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: Playing in Standard" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Standard_format?section=2&veaction=editsource" title="Edit section's source code: Playing in Standard"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></h2>
<dl><dd><i>For playing in other game formats, see <a href="/wiki/Game_format" title="Game format">Game format</a>.</i></dd></dl>
<p>Players are able to select Standard format through the <a href="/wiki/Constructed" title="Constructed">Constructed</a> selection screen, or when challenging a friend to a <a href="/wiki/Friendly_Challenge" title="Friendly Challenge">Friendly Challenge</a>. An icon shows the current Standard year's <a href="#The_Hearthstone_Zodiac">zodiac</a> if Standard is selected. Matches played in Standard format will always see both players obeying the format's restrictions; players queuing for a Standard format match will never be matched against players from other formats.<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>When playing a Standard game, players may only choose decks which are built entirely from Standard <a href="/wiki/Card_set" title="Card set">card sets</a>, within the rotating two-calendar year window. In the deck creation or selection screens, Standard-legal decks are displayed with plain unadorned borders, while those containing Wild cards show a thorny vine wrapped around the border. Deck builders can convert a Wild deck to Standard using a button when hovering over the deck name, in which case Wild cards in the deck will be marked to allow for easy replacement. When editing a Standard deck, Wild-only cards from the player's collection are not displayed. The conversion can also be reversed, removing the restrictions on adding Wild cards to the deck.
</p><p>During Standard games, cards that provide access to other cards randomly will only select from Standard sets, whereas in Wild they would be able to select from all cards. Mechanics restricted this way include <a href="/wiki/Summon" title="Summon">summoning</a> or <a href="/wiki/Transform" title="Transform">transforming</a> into random minions.<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-3"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> This focuses the gameplay on the more refined set of cards in the format, and prevents players from using random chance to access cards that have been restricted from the format. On the other hand, cards which specifically generate cards from other sets remain fully functional in Standard. For example, during the Year of the Kraken, <span class="nobreak cardSetImage" style="white-space: nowrap"><a href="/wiki/The_Grand_Tournament" title=" "><img alt=" " src="/images/The_Grand_Tournament_-_SVG_logo.svg?163fba" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="18" height="18" data-file-width="512" data-file-height="512"></a><a href="/wiki/Ball_of_Spiders"><span class="ajaxttlink rarity3">Ball of Spiders</span></a></span> was valid even though the <a href="/wiki/Webspinner" title="Webspinner">Webspinners</a> it generated were from three years earlier in the <i><a href="/wiki/Curse_of_Naxxramas" title="Curse of Naxxramas">Curse of Naxxramas</a></i> set.<sup id="cite_ref-WEB_4-0" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-WEB-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>4<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> <span class="nobreak cardSetImage" style="white-space: nowrap"><a href="/wiki/The_Witchwood" title=" "><img alt=" " src="/images/The_Witchwood_-_SVG_logo.svg?2ec6f0" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="18" height="18" data-file-width="512" data-file-height="512"></a><a href="/wiki/Toki,_Time-Tinker"><span class="ajaxttlink rarity5">Toki, Time-Tinker</span></a></span> was another example as she was able to add a random <a href="/wiki/Legendary" class="mw-redirect" title="Legendary">legendary</a> minion from Wild format into the player's hand.
</p>
<h2><span class="mw-headline" id="The_Standard_year">The Standard year</span><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/wiki/Standard_format?veaction=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: The Standard year" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Standard_format?section=3&veaction=editsource" title="Edit section's source code: The Standard year"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></h2>
<p>The release of the first expansion each year marks the start of a new "Standard year" in <i>Hearthstone</i>, also referred to as a "<i>Hearthstone</i> year".
</p>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="Card_set_rotation_schedule">Card set rotation schedule</span><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/wiki/Standard_format?veaction=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Card set rotation schedule" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Standard_format?section=4&veaction=editsource" title="Edit section's source code: Card set rotation schedule"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></h3>
<p>With the beginning of each new Standard year, the selection of <a href="/wiki/Card_set" title="Card set">card sets</a> available in Standard is updated, with the oldest year of card sets being moved to Wild format, allowing new sets to take their place in the new Standard year. By definition, Standard format includes only cards from the current and previous Standard years, alongside the <a href="/wiki/Core" title="Core">core set</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-3" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Note that the selection is <i>not</i> updated upon release of expansions past the first in any given year. This was intentionally designed in order to minimize the disruption caused by players having to constantly adjust their decks being invalidated by the frequent changes in the format, which can be especially disorienting to <a href="/wiki/Returning_player_experience" title="Returning player experience">returning players</a>.<sup id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-5"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>5<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-6" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-6"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>6<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>

</p><p># Mini-set
</p><p>% Special card set
</p><p>There are currently no plans for older card sets to be reintroduced into Standard later on.<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p>
<h3><span class="mw-headline" id="The_Hearthstone_Zodiac">The <i>Hearthstone</i> Zodiac</span><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/wiki/Standard_format?veaction=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: The Hearthstone Zodiac" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="https://hearthstone.wiki.gg/wiki/Standard_format?section=5&veaction=editsource" title="Edit section's source code: The Hearthstone Zodiac"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></h3>
<div class="thumb tright"><div class="thumbinner" style="width:102px;"><a href="/wiki/File:Year_of_the_Kraken_constellation.png" class="image"><img src="/images/thumb/Year_of_the_Kraken_constellation.png/100px-Year_of_the_Kraken_constellation.png?fda2a7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="100" height="122" class="thumbimage" data-file-width="235" data-file-height="286"></a>  <div class="thumbcaption"><div class="magnify"><a href="/wiki/File:Year_of_the_Kraken_constellation.png" class="internal" title="Enlarge"></a></div>The constellation of the Kraken</div></div></div>
<p>With the introduction of Standard and Wild formats in 2016, each <i>Hearthstone</i> year is now symbolized by a zodiacal constellation formed from stars in Azeroth's night sky to differentiate each different year in Standard.<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-5" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> The <a href="/wiki/Hearthstone_lore#The_Hearthstone_Zodiac" title="Hearthstone lore">lore</a> behind this is that the new year is heralded by a new constellation coming into alignment above Azeroth, marking "a time of jubilation and raucous revelry wherever Hearthstone is played".<sup id="cite_ref-AB_1-6" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-AB-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> Each year's constellation is marked by a different beast.
</p><p>The current year's zodiac animal acts as a symbol for Standard format, as seen on the <a href="/wiki/Game_format" title="Game format">game format</a> selection button on the <a href="/wiki/Constructed" title="Constructed">Constructed</a> screen.
</p>
